subject: Supplier portal VAT format validation blocking NovusEdge onboarding

Cc: procurement@novusedge.com
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Trouble finishing supplier setup — VAT format rejected

Hi Diego,

I'm trying to complete our supplier onboarding form for NovusEdge in the Redwood supplier portal (Coupa flow) but the VAT/tax-id field keeps rejecting our number. We tried both with the country prefix (IE1234567A) and without (1234567A) and get the same "invalid tax number" error. Screenshot attached.

We can't move forward to PO provisioning until this is fixed — can you or someone on your side take a look? Happy to hop on a quick screen-share if that helps.

Thanks,
Sara Kline
Head of Procurement
NovusEdge

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Sara Kline <sara.k@novusedge.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble finishing supplier setup — VAT format rejected

Thanks for the ping. I pulled the validation logs for NovusEdge and see a 400 response from the VAT normalization step: our current regex expects the EU country code to be omitted and strips only non-digit characters, so values with alpha prefix (e.g., "IE1234567A") or embedded spaces are failing to match.

Short-term workaround: Monica can apply a manual vendor create and input the normalized VAT (strip spaces and leading country code) so the account can get a PO. I've attached a trimmed validation log excerpt. I also opened INF-11234 in Jira to track a permanent fix (update normalization to accept common EU formats and run against the tax ID library).

Notes:
- This affects certain EU vendors only; non-EU tax-ids are fine.
- Risk: if we incorrectly normalize we could accept invalid IDs; we should add unit tests and a regression check.

[Attachment: validation_error_log.txt (txt)]

Ben
Platform Reliability Engineer

From: Sara Kline <sara.k@novusedge.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 9 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trouble finishing supplier setup — VAT format rejected

Thanks Ben — that explanation helps. We used Chrome on Win10 and pasted the VAT exactly as it appears on our invoices: "IE 1234567 A" (with spaces). If stripping spaces and the country code will let you create the vendor record manually that's fine for the PX team to start receiving POs.

Can you share ETA for the permanent change? We have a PO scheduled for next Wednesday and want to avoid repeating manual steps again for other EU suppliers.

Sara
